mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_place_logs (trip_id, place_id, name, memo, linked_expense_id, visited_at, detected_by_gps) VALUES (#{trip_id}, #{place_id}, #{name}, #{memo}, #{linked_expense_id}, #{visited_at}, #{detected_by_gps})
mapper.select: SELECT id, trip_id, place_id, name, memo, linked_expense_id, visited_at, detected_by_gps, created_at FROM trip_place_logs WHERE trip_id = #{trip_id} ORDER BY visited_at ASC
